is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995S (East-kdr) and Vgsc L995F (West-kdr) (page 3, 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper states that 30 mosquitoes were genotyped for East-kdr, and one was found to be heterozygous (page 3, 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from field breeding sites in Yamoussoukro, Côte d'Ivoire (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical research note reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies the location as rice fields at the outskirts of the city of Yamoussoukro (6°49′13″ N/5°16′36″ W) (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper describes a specific, small-scale monitoring event in 2015. While it mentions being part of a larger monitoring study, the data presented is specific to this collection.

supplement.evidence: The necessary genotype data (sample size and results) is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study reports the first detection of the East-African kdr mutation (Vgsc L995S) in a single heterozygous Anopheles gambiae s.l. specimen collected in Yamoussoukro, Côte d'Ivoire, in 2015. The study also includes insecticide susceptibility bioassays for deltamethrin, malathion, bendiocarb, and DDT.
